note: Step 3 DOM-grounded block specs. Anchoring selectors + cell structure extracted from live DOM via block-probe.js across 44 representative pages. KEY FINDING: the site is built with TWO page builders (custom WordPress templates + Elementor); most blocks have a DIFFERENT DOM implementation in each, so a block needs up to 2-3 detectors/transformers. Invisible to the visual tree and to name-based consolidation.

builders_detected.wp-custom: Bootstrap-grid custom WordPress templates (.row > .col-*, .accordion.faq-card, splide + slick carousels). Accordions on 10 pages.
builders_detected.elementor: Elementor page builder (.e-n-accordion > details, .elementor-element-*, swiper carousels). Accordions on 18 pages.

implementations.cells: 1 col per row: question text + answer body
1 col per row: summary text + details body

blocks.variant_resolution: One canonical block, TWO detectors (Bootstrap vs native <details>). At scale across 44 grounded pages: Elementor .e-n-accordion on 18, wp-custom .accordion on 10. Both map to the same EDS accordion block.

implementations.cells: 1 cell per card; layout from Bootstrap col-* modifier

blocks.variant_resolution: Confirmed ONE block: a Bootstrap column grid. The 37 merged names (recipe-cards, event-card-grid, portal-cards…) are all .row>.col-* with different content — CSS/content variants, NOT distinct blocks. Resolves the biggest possible_variant_group.
One canonical block, THREE carousel libraries confirmed at scale: Slick (10 pages), Splide (6), Swiper/Elementor (3). Each needs its own slide-extraction selector; all map to one EDS carousel block.
